deploy-bot: Starting release roll: release/2026-04-10. Order: api@2.8.0 -> runtime@4.5.0 -> console@2.1.0 -> router@3.4.0. Change window 22:00-00:00 UTC. Canary 5%->20%->100%.
maria: Quick ask: please pin api for 40m during canary. Runtime patch touches kv eviction.
dan: Confirmed: kv_eviction_mode=adaptive, new batching enabled. Recommend pin and extended smoke (6m) at each ramp.
kevin: I will flip console flag header_swap=true at canary start and run 3 quick smokes. Rollback on sustained 5xx or >10% fallbacks.
ops-bot: Reserving +4 GPUs eu-west1 for 60m starting 21:55 UTC.
deploy-bot: Wave 1 (5%) starting ts=1725000000. Pinning api@2.8.0 for 40m.
maria: Smoke @4m: no 5xx, kv-hit down 2% (expected), token errs 0.0%. Proceed.
kevin: Flipped header_swap=true at 22:03:12 UTC. Verified header present.
sasha: Release notes/rollback runbook updated: https://internal/docs/releases/2026-04-10.
deploy-bot: Ramping to 20% now.
-- monitor --
ops-bot: Alert: p95 in eu-west increased 60% for 4m; kv-miss rose to 12% in subset.
dan: This breaches our kv-miss threshold. Initiating rollback per runbook.
kevin: Reverting header_swap=false and applying router override to stable mapping.
ops-bot: Releasing reserved GPUs at 22:19 UTC.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Unpinning api@2.8.0. Marking release aborted.
sasha: Filing postmortem and tagging runtime, router, and observability teams.
maria: Good coordination. Next run: add preflight kv stress under regional load and longer smokes.
